questions.content:
一、（1）过程I:圆轨道法向动力学

$$\begin{array} { c } { { \displaystyle \Delta N = m g \cos \theta + m \frac { v ^ { 2 } } { R } } } \\ { { f = \mu N } } \end{array}\tag{1}$$

切向动力学

$$m \frac { d v } { d t } = - f - m g \sin \theta\tag{2}$$

代入得到

$$m \frac { d v } { d t } = - \mu ( m g \cos \theta + m \frac { v ^ { 2 } } { R } ) - m g \sin \theta\tag{3}$$

注意到

$$\frac { d v } { d t } = \frac { d v } { d \theta } \frac { d \theta } { d t } = \frac { 1 } { 2 R } \frac { d v ^ { 2 } } { d \theta }\tag{4}$$

从而整理得到

$$\frac { d v ^ { 2 } } { d \theta } + 2 \mu v ^ { 2 } = - 2 g R ( \mu \cos \theta + \sin \theta )\tag{5}$$

根据提示中的通解有

$$v ^ { 2 } = e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } \left( C + \int - 2 g R \left( \mu \cos \theta + \sin \theta \right) e ^ { 2 \mu \theta } d \theta \right)\tag{6}$$

根据分部积分有

$$\begin{aligned} &\int \cos ax \cdot e^{bx}dx = (b\cos ax + a\sin ax)\frac{e^{bx}}{a^{2} + b^{2}}\\ &\int \sin ax \cdot e^{bx}dx = (b\sin ax - a\cos ax)\frac{e^{bx}}{a^{2} + b^{2}}\\ \end{aligned}\tag{7}$$

代入积分，得到

$$v ^ { 2 } = C e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } - \frac { 2 g R } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } ( 2 \mu ^ { 2 } \cos \theta + 3 \mu \sin \theta - \cos \theta )\tag{8}$$

初值条件: $\theta = 0 , v = v _ { 0 }$ .代入得到

$$C = v _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } + 2 g R \frac { 2 \mu ^ { 2 } - 1 } { 4 \mu ^ { 2 } + 1 }\tag{9}$$

得到

$$v ^ { 2 } = - \frac { 2 g R } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } \left( 2 \mu ^ { 2 } \cos \theta + 3 \mu \sin \theta - \cos \theta \right) + \left( v _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } + 2 g R \frac { 2 \mu ^ { 2 } - 1 } { 4 \mu ^ { 2 } + 1 } \right) e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta }\tag{10}$$

经过一整圈之后 $\theta = 2 \pi$ ，即有

$$v _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } = v _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } e ^ { - 4 \mu \pi } + 2 g R \frac { 1 - 2 \mu ^ { 2 } } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } ( 1 - e ^ { - 4 \mu \pi } )\tag{11}$$

或

$$v _ { 1 } = \sqrt { v _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } e ^ { - 4 \mu \pi } + 2 g R \frac { 1 - 2 \mu ^ { 2 } } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } ( 1 - e ^ { - 4 \mu \pi } ) } .\tag{11}$$

特例: $\mu = 0$ 时有 $v _ { 1 } = v _ { 0 }$ .（能量守恒)

(2) 过程II:经过正弦轨道

首先求解曲率半径

$$\begin{array} { l } { y ^ { \prime } = A \cos x } \\ { y ^ { \prime \prime } = - A \sin x } \end{array}\tag{12}$$

根据曲率半径公式

$$\rho=\frac{(1+y^{\prime 2})^{\frac{3}{2}}}{y^{\prime \prime}}\tag{13}$$

得到

$$\rho=\frac{\left(1+A^{2}\cos^{2}x\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{A\sin x}\tag{14}$$

根据几何关系

$$\tan \phi = y^{\prime} = A\cos x\tag{15}$$

从而

$$\cos \phi = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + A^{2} \cos^{2}x}}\tag{16}$$

能量守恒

$$\frac{1}{2}mv^{2}+mgy=\frac{1}{2}mv_{1}^{2}\tag{17}$$

得到速度满足

$$v ^ { 2 } = v _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } - 2 g y = v _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } - 2 g A \sin x\tag{18}$$

动力学关系

$$m g \cos \phi - N = m \frac { v ^ { 2 } } { \rho }\tag{19}$$

得到支持力

$$N = mg\frac{1 + A^{2} + A^{2}\sin^{2}x}{\left( 1 + A^{2}\cos^{2}x \right)^{\frac{3}{2}}} - \frac{mv_{1}^{2}A\sin x}{\left( 1 + A^{2}\cos^{2}x \right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\tag{20}$$

假设会分离，则

$$N = 0\tag{21}$$

化简得到方程

$$g A ^ { 2 } \sin ^ { 2 } x - v _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } A \sin x + g ( 1 + A ^ { 2 } ) = 0\tag{22}$$

判别式

$$\Delta = v _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } A ^ { 2 } - 4 g ^ { 2 } A ^ { 2 } ( 1 + A ^ { 2 } ) < 0\tag{23}$$

从而方程无解，不会脱离正弦轨道

(3) 过程III:圆轨道滑落

能量

$$\frac{1}{2}mv^{2}=\frac{1}{2}mv_{1}^{2}+mgr(1-\cos\theta)\tag{24}$$

分离时

$$g \cos \theta = \frac { v ^ { 2 } } { r }\tag{25}$$

解得

$$\cos \theta = \frac { 2 } { 3 } + \frac { v _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } } { 3 g r }\tag{26}$$

或

$$\theta = \arccos \left( \frac { 2 } { 3 } + \frac { v _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } } { 3 g r } \right)\tag{27}$$

二、令OA杆角速度、AB杆相对于OA杆角速度、BC杆相对于AB杆角速度为

$$\begin{array} { r l } & { \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { O A } = \omega \hat { z } } \\ & { \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { A B } = 2 \omega \hat { z } } \\ & { \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { B C } = \omega \hat { z } } \end{array}\tag{1}$$

首先求解速度

A点速度的求解:

$$\overrightarrow { v } _ { A } = \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { O A } \times \overrightarrow { r } _ { A } = ( \sqrt { 3 } \hat { y } - 3 \hat { x } ) \omega l\tag{2}$$

B点速度的求解:

取OA转动系

$$\overrightarrow { v } _ { B } = \overrightarrow { r } _ { B } \div \omega _ { O A } \times \overrightarrow { r } _ { B }$$

$$\overrightarrow { v } _ { B } ^ { \prime } = \omega _ { O A } \times \overrightarrow { A B }\tag{3}$$

(4)

$$\overrightarrow { v } _ { B } ^ { \prime } = ( 3 + \sqrt { 3 } ) \omega l \hat { y }\tag{5}$$

C点速度的求解:

取OA转动参考系之后再取AB转动参考系

$$\overrightarrow{a}'_{C}=\overrightarrow{a}'_{C}+\omega_{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}\tag{6}$$

$$\vec { v } _ { C } ^ { \prime } = \omega _ { B C } \times \vec { B } \vec { C }\tag{7}$$

$$\vec { v } _ { C } ^ { \prime } = ( 2 \hat { y } ) \omega l\tag{8}$$

$$\overline { { \overline { { v } } } } _ { C } = \overline { { \overline { { v } } } } _ { C } ^ { \prime } + \omega _ { O A } \times \overline { { r _ { C } } } = ( 4 \hat { x } + ( 3 \div \sqrt { 3 } ) \hat { y } ) \omega l\tag{9}$$

加速度求解

取OA转动系后再取AB转动系

$$\overrightarrow { v } _ { C } ^ { \prime \prime } = \omega l \hat { x }\tag{10}$$

$$\overrightarrow { a ^ { ' } } _ { C } = \omega ^ { 2 } l \hat { y }\tag{11}$$

则

$$\overrightarrow { a } _ { C } ^ { \prime } = \overrightarrow { a } _ { C } ^ { \prime \prime } + 2 \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { A B } \times \overrightarrow { v } _ { C } ^ { \prime \prime } + \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { A B } \times ( \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { A B } \times \overrightarrow { A C } ) = ( 1 3 \hat { y } - 4 \hat { x } ) \omega ^ { 2 } l\tag{12}$$

$$\overrightarrow { a } _ { C } = \overrightarrow { a } _ { C } ^ { \prime } + 2 \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { A B } \times \overrightarrow { v } _ { C } + \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { O A } \times ( \overrightarrow { \omega } _ { O A } \times \overrightarrow { r _ { C } } ) = ( 2 2 \hat { y } - ( 9 + \sqrt { 3 } ) \hat { x } ) \omega ^ { 2 } l\tag{13}$$

可以验证，求导将得到相同答案。

(2）在地系下直接写出三根杆子的角速度

$$\begin{array} { r l } & { \vec { \omega } _ { 1 } = \omega \hat { z } } \\ & { \vec { \omega } _ { 2 } = 3 \omega \hat { z } } \\ & { \vec { \omega } _ { 3 } = 4 \omega \hat { z } } \end{array}\tag{14}$$

受力情况如图（figure1），三根杆子的角加速度分别设为 $\beta _ { 1 } , \beta _ { 2 } , \beta _ { 3 }$

对于 $OA$ 杆绕O点转动定理

$$m g \sqrt { 3 } l \sin 3 0 ^ { o } + F _ { 2 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \sin 3 0 ^ { o } - F _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \cos 3 0 ^ { o } = \frac { 1 } { 3 } m ( 2 \sqrt { 3 } l ) ^ { 2 } \beta _ { 1 }\tag{15}$$

对于AB杆绕质心转动定理

$$F _ { 1 } \cdot \frac { \sqrt { 2 } } { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } \div F _ { 2 } \cdot \frac { \sqrt { 2 } } { 2 } l \cos 4 5 ^ { o } \div F _ { 3 } \cdot \frac { \sqrt { 2 } } { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - F _ { 4 } \cdot \frac { \sqrt { 2 } } { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } = \frac { 1 } { 1 2 } m ( \sqrt { 2 } l ) ^ { 2 } \beta _ { 2 }\tag{16}$$

对于AB杆质心运动定理

$$F_{1} - F_{3} = m a_{1x}\tag{17}$$

$$F_{2} - F_{4}-mg=ma_{1y}\tag{18}$$

对于BC杆绕质心转动定理

$$F_{3} \cdot \frac{1}{2}l = \frac{1}{12}m l^{2} \beta_3\tag{19}$$

对于BC杆质心运动定理

$$F_{3} = m a_{2x}\tag{20}$$

$$F_{1} + mg = - ma_{2y}\tag{21}$$

加速度关联

$$a _ { 1 x } = \beta _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \cos 3 0 ^ { o } - \omega ^ { 2 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \sin 3 0 ^ { o } - \beta _ { 2 } \frac { \sqrt { 2 } } { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - ( 3 \omega ) ^ { 2 } \frac { \sqrt { 2 } } { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o }\tag{22}$$

$$a _ { 2 x } = \beta _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \cos 3 0 ^ { o } - \omega ^ { 2 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \sin 3 0 ^ { o } - \beta _ { 2 } \sqrt { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - ( 3 \omega ) ^ { 2 } \sqrt { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - \beta _ { 3 } \frac { 1 } { 2 } l\tag{23}$$

$$a _ { 1 y } = ( 3 \omega ) ^ { 2 } \frac { \sqrt { 2 } } { 2 } l \cdot \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - \frac { \sqrt { 2 } } { 2 } \beta _ { 3 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - \beta _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \sin 3 0 ^ { o } - \omega ^ { 2 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \cos 3 0 ^ { o }\tag{24}$$

$$a _ { 2 y } = ( 3 \omega ) ^ { 2 } \sqrt { 2 } l \cdot \sin 4 5 ^ { \circ } - \sqrt { 2 } \beta _ { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { \circ } - \beta _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \sin 3 0 ^ { \circ } - \omega ^ { 2 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \cos 3 0 ^ { \circ } + ( 4 \omega ) ^ { 2 } \frac { 1 } { 2 } l\tag{25}$$

并代入 $\omega ^ { 2 } l = g ,$

解得

$$\begin{aligned} \beta _ { 1 } & = 2 . 6 4 4 2 9 6 9 7 1 \omega ^ { 2 } \\ \beta _ { 2 } & = 4 . 9 7 2 4 5 8 2 7 3 \omega ^ { 2 } \\ \beta _ { 3 } & = - 1 1 . 6 5 7 4 3 7 3 5 \omega ^ { 2 } \end{aligned}\tag{26}$$

最终C点加速度

$$a _ { C x } = \beta _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \cos 3 0 ^ { o } - \omega ^ { 2 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \sin 3 0 ^ { o } - \beta _ { 2 } \sqrt { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - ( 3 \omega ) ^ { 2 } \sqrt { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - \beta _ { 3 } l$$

$$a _ { C y } = ( 3 \omega ) ^ { 2 } \sqrt { 2 } l \cdot \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - \sqrt { 2 } \beta _ { 2 } l \sin 4 5 ^ { o } - \beta _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \sin 3 0 ^ { o } - \omega ^ { 2 } \cdot 2 \sqrt { 3 } l \cos 3 0 ^ { o } + ( 4 \omega ) ^ { 2 } \cdot l\tag{27}$$

代入数据得

$$\begin{array} { c } { { a _ { C x } = - 1 9 . 4 2 9 0 4 5 4 2 g } } \\ { { a _ { C y } = 1 2 . 4 4 7 4 8 5 0 2 g } } \end{array}\tag{28}$$

tags: 实验/力学/流体力学/雷诺数与层流
实验/力学/粘滞系数/毛细管法
questions.content:
三、

利用欧拉方程

$$0 = \rho \overrightarrow{g} - \nabla p + \mu \nabla^2 w \tag{1}$$

略去场点附近的曲率，从而可以略去重力

$$\mu \nabla^2 \vec{u} = \nabla p \tag{2}$$

认为液体为沿方向有速度分布的层流，沿 $\theta$ 方向有压强分布

$$\frac{dp}{R d\theta} = \mu \frac{d^2 u}{dy^2} \tag{3}$$

两侧分别为纯 $\theta$ 与纯 $y$ 的函数，从而只能等于常数，令

$$\frac{dp}{R d\theta} = -k \tag{4-5}$$

$$\mu \frac{d^2 u}{dy^2} = -k'$$

从而解得

$$\begin{array}{c} p(\theta) = p(0) - \mu R k \theta \\ u = \frac{1}{2} k y (h - y) \end{array} \tag{6-7}$$

流量约束

$$Q = \int_{0}^{h} 2Lu(y)dy = \int_{0}^{h} \frac{1}{2}ky(h - y) \cdot 2Ldy \tag{8}$$

完成积分得到

$$k = \frac{6 \dot{Q}}{L h^3} \tag{9}$$

边界条件为

$$p(\theta_{max}) = p_{atm} \tag{10}$$

从而解得

$$p(0) = p_{atm} + \mu R k \theta_{max} \tag{11}$$

压强分布

$$p(\theta) = p_{max} + \mu R k (\theta_{max} - \theta) \tag{12}$$

圆柱所受抬升的作用力

$$F = \int_{-\theta_{max}}^{\theta_{max}} (p - p_{atm}) L R d\theta \cos\theta \tag{13}$$

其中

$$\int \theta \cos\theta d\theta = \int \theta d\sin\theta = \theta\sin\theta - \int \sin\theta d\theta = \theta\sin\theta + \cos\theta \tag{14}$$

完成积分得到

$$F = \frac{12 \mu Q R^{2}}{h^{3}} \theta_{max} \sin \theta_{max} \tag{15}$$

平衡时

$$F = mg \tag{16}$$

从而水膜厚度为

$$h = \sqrt[3]{\frac{12\mu Q R^{2}}{mg} \theta_{max} \sin \theta_{max}} \tag{17}$$

(1) 转动导致一个线性的速度场分布，从而

$$u = \frac{1}{2} k y (h - y) + \omega R \frac{y}{h} \tag{18}$$

转动带来摩擦力

$$f = \mu \frac{du}{dy} = \frac{1}{2} \mu k (h - 2y) \sim \frac{\mu \omega R}{h} \tag{19}$$

上式第一项左右对称，不带来摩擦力矩，第二项导致一个力矩为

$$M = - \int R \frac{\mu \omega R}{h} L R d\theta = - \frac{2 \theta_{max} \mu R^3 \omega L}{h} \tag{20}$$

角动量定理

$$M = \frac{1}{2} m R^{2} \frac{d\omega}{dt} \tag{21}$$

最终得到解为

$$\omega = \omega_{0} e^{-\frac{4 \theta_{max} \mu R^3 L}{m h} t} \tag{22}$$

questions.title: 第 04 题
tags: 电磁学/电磁感应/动生与感生电动势/导体在磁场中运动

questions.content:
四、

(1)

$\sigma \to \infty$ ，时刻保持静电平衡。

切割磁感线产生电动势

$$
\pmb{E} = \pmb{B} d v\tag{1}
$$

等效电容，带电量

$$
q = C E = \epsilon _ { 0 } \pi R ^ { 2 } B v\tag{2}
$$

电流

$$
I = \frac { d q } { d t } = \epsilon _ { 0 } \pi R ^ { 2 } B \frac { d v } { d t }\tag{3}
$$

牛顿第二定律

$$
mg - BId = m\frac{dv}{dt}\tag{4}
$$

可知

$$
\frac { d v } { d t } = \frac { m g } { m + B ^ { 2 } \epsilon _ { 0 } \pi R ^ { 2 } d }\tag{5}
$$

从而

$$
x _ { 1 } ( t ) = \frac { 1 } { 2 } \frac { m g } { m + B ^ { 2 } \epsilon _ { 0 } \pi R ^ { 2 } d } t ^ { 2 }\tag{6}
$$

(2)取下落运动参照系，附加电场

$$
E ^ { \prime } = v B\tag{7}
$$

微观欧姆定律（其中 $\delta$ 为导体圆盘端面电荷密度）

$$
\kappa B - \frac { \delta } { \epsilon _ { 0 } } = \frac { j } { \sigma }\tag{8}
$$

电流关系

$$
j = \dot { \delta } , I = j \pi R ^ { 2 }\tag{9}
$$

从而

$$
\dot { \delta } = - \frac { \sigma } { \epsilon _ { 0 } } \delta + \sigma v B ,\tag{10}
$$

牛顿第二定律

$$
mg - BId = m\frac{dv}{dt}\tag{11}
$$

联立可知

$$
\ddot { \delta } = B \sigma g - ( \frac { B d \pi R ^ { 2 } } { m } + \frac { 1 } { B \epsilon _ { 0 } } ) B \sigma \dot { \delta } ,\tag{12}
$$

$$
a = B \sigma ( \frac { B d \pi R ^ { 2 } } { m } + \frac { 1 } { B \epsilon _ { 0 } } )\tag{13}
$$

$$
b = B \sigma g\tag{14}
$$

积分，得

$$
\dot { \delta } = \frac { b } { a } ( 1 - e ^ { - a t } )\tag{15}
$$

积分，得

$$
\delta = \frac { b } { a } ( t + \frac { 1 } { a } ( e ^ { - a t } - 1 ) )\tag{16}
$$

则

$$
\begin{aligned} &v = \frac { \dot { \delta } } { B \sigma } + \frac { \delta } { B \epsilon _ { 0 } } \\&= \frac { b } { B \sigma a } ( 1 - e ^ { - a t } ) + \frac { b } { B \epsilon _ { 0 } a } ( t + \frac { 1 } { a } ( e ^ { - a t } - 1 ) )\\ \end{aligned}\tag{17}
$$

积分，得

$$
x_{2}(t)=\frac{b}{B\sigma a}\left(t+\frac{1}{a}(e^{\alpha t}-1)\right)+\frac{b}{B\epsilon_{0}a}\left(\frac{1}{2}t^{2}-\frac{1}{a}\left(\frac{1}{a}\left((e^{\alpha t}-1)+t\right)\right)\right)\tag{18}
$$

代入

$$
\begin{array} { c } { { \displaystyle \alpha = B \sigma ( \frac { B d \pi R ^ { 2 } } { m } - \frac { 1 } { B \epsilon _ { 0 } } ) } } \\ { { \displaystyle b = B \sigma g } } \end{array}\tag{19}
$$

最终化简得到

$$
\begin{aligned} &x_{2}(t) = \frac{mte_{1}g}{\sigma(B^{2}e_{0}d\pi R^{2} + m)}\{t - \frac{mte_{0}}{\sigma(B^{2}e_{0}d\pi R^{2} + m)}(e^{-R\pi(\frac{t-\mu^{2}}{m}-\frac{1}{t_{0}}\mathbf{F}} - 1))\\ &\cdot \frac{mg}{(B^{2}e_{0}d\pi R^{2} - m)}\{\frac{1}{2}t^{2} - \frac{mte_{0}}{\sigma(B^{2}e_{0}d\pi R^{2} + m)}(\frac{mte_{0}}{\sigma(B^{2}e_{0}d\pi R^{2} + m)}\{(e^{-R\pi(\frac{t-\mu^{2}}{m}-\frac{1}{t_{0}}\mathbf{F} - 1) - t)}\})\\ \end{aligned}\tag{20}
$$

questions.content:
五、

（1）亥姆霍兹线圈轴线磁场

$$B(z)=\frac{1}{2}\mu_0IR^2\left[\frac{1}{\left(R^2+(\frac{L}{2}-z)^2\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}+\frac{1}{\left(R^2+(\frac{L}{2}+z)^2\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\right]\tag{1}$$

题述 $L = R$。

从而

$$B(0)=0.71554\frac{\mu_0 I}{R}$$

计算可知

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2B(z)}{\mathrm{d}z^2}\bigg|_{z=0}=0.$$

从而近似为匀强磁场。

（2）转动定律

可以得到简谐振动方程

$$\begin{aligned} &\because\quad J\ddot{\theta} = -\mu B\theta, \\ &\therefore\quad \ddot{\theta} + \omega^{2}\theta = 0, \end{aligned}$$

其中 $\omega = \sqrt{\frac{\mu B}{J}}$。

小振动周期

$$T = 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{J}{\mu(B(0)+B_e)}},$$

化简，得到

$$I = \frac{4\pi^2 J}{\mu} - \frac{B_e}{\alpha}$$

从而

$$a = \frac{4\pi^2 J}{\mu},\quad b = -\frac{B_{el}}{\alpha}$$

（3）再次写出运动方程

$$J\ddot{\theta} = -\mu B_{\perp}\theta$$

注意到 $\ddot{\theta} = \frac{1}{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}\dot{\theta}^2}{\mathrm{d}\theta}$，有

$$-\frac{J\,\mathrm{d}\dot{\theta}^2}{\mu} = B_1\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta$$

代入最低阶近似 $B_1 = B_e + B(0) - kt$，两侧在半周期内积分

$$\begin{aligned} &\int_{0}^{0} -\frac{J\,\mathrm{d}\dot{\theta}^{2}}{\mu} = \int_{-\theta_{0}}^{\theta_{0}-\Delta\theta_{0}} (B_{e} - B(0) + kt)\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta \\ &= \int_{-\theta_{0}}^{\theta_{0}-\Delta\theta_{0}} (B_{e} + B(0))\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta + \int_{-\theta_{0}}^{\theta_{0}+\Delta\theta_{0}} kt\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta \end{aligned}$$

上式左侧等于0。对于右侧第一项，直接积分。而对于右侧第二项，处理时代入零阶解 $\theta_0\cos\omega t$。

$$0 = (B_e + B(0))\theta_0\Delta\theta_0 + \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{\omega}} kt\,\theta_0\cos\omega t\,(-\omega)\theta_0\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{d}t$$

上式右侧含有积分

$$\int_{0}^{\pi} x\sin x\cos x\,\mathrm{d}x$$

该积分是平凡的，分部积分得到

$$\int_{0}^{\pi} x\sin x\cos x\,\mathrm{d}x = -\frac{\pi}{4}$$

从而

$$0 = (B_e + B(0))\theta_0\Delta\theta_0 + \frac{k\pi\theta_0^2}{4\omega}$$

注意到

$$k = \frac{\mathrm{d}B}{\mathrm{d}t} \approx \frac{\Delta B}{\frac{\pi}{\omega}}$$

从而上式为

$$0 = \frac{\Delta\theta_0}{\theta_0} + \frac{\Delta B}{4B}$$

从而得到守恒量

$$\theta_0 B^{\frac{1}{4}} = \text{constant}$$

则

$$m = \frac{1}{4}$$

（4）显然角动量为

$$L = J\dot{\theta} = -\omega\theta_0 J\sin\omega t$$

角位移为

$$\theta = \theta_0\cos\omega t$$

显然图为半长轴为 $\theta_0$，半短轴为 $\omega\theta_0 J$ 的椭圆。

其面积为

$$A = \pi ab = \pi\theta_0^2 J\omega$$

其中

$$\omega = \sqrt{\frac{\mu B}{J}}$$

从而

$$\sqrt{A} = \sqrt{\pi} J^{\frac{1}{4}}\mu^{\frac{1}{4}}\theta_0 B^{\frac{1}{4}}$$

从而

$$\frac{\sqrt{A}}{L_{\text{constant}}} = \sqrt{\pi} J^{\frac{1}{4}}\mu^{\frac{1}{4}}$$

该比值为常数，这启示我们 $L$-$\theta$ 图（相图）围成的面积为守恒量。

$$\oint p\,\mathrm{d}q = \text{constant}$$

其中 $p$ 为广义动量，$q$ 为广义坐标。

questions.title: 第 06 题
tags: 实验/电磁学/传输线/特征阻抗
实验/电磁学/传输线/驻波与干涉条件
实验/电磁学/电路设计/等效电路建模

questions.content:
六、

(1) 画出等效电路图如下

判断思路:①直流不短路，说明电感没有单独位于一个支路上；②高频区域阻抗趋于零，说明电容位于单独支路上；③阻抗存在极大值，属并联谐振现象

(2) 单位长度上分布电容等价于一个内外半径为 $R_{1}, R_{2}$ 的柱形电容器:

$$C = \frac{2 \pi \epsilon_{0}}{\ln \frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}}\tag{1}$$

求解分布电感时，由于中空圆柱体的内外表面均存在趋肤效应，且根据题设电流密度处处相同，则电流在内柱面和外柱面上按半径分配。显然，单位长度上内禀磁通仅由内柱面上电流提供。

$$\phi = \int_{R_{1}}^{R_{2}} \frac{\mu_{0} i}{2 \pi r} \frac{R_{1}}{R_{1} + R_{2}} dr = \frac{\mu_{0} i}{2 \pi} \frac{R_{1}}{R_{1} + R_{2}} \ln \frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}\tag{2}$$

从而单位长度上分布电感

$$L = \frac{\phi}{i} = \frac{\mu_{0}}{2\pi} \frac{R_{1}}{R_{1} + R_{2}} \ln \frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}\tag{3}$$

单位长度上电阻 $\lambda = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\sigma \omega \mu}}$

$$R = \frac{1}{\sigma} \frac{1}{2\pi(R_{1} + R_{2})\lambda}\tag{4}$$

从而体系复阻抗

$$Z = \frac{\frac{1}{j \omega C} \left( R + j \omega L \right)}{\frac{1}{j \omega C} + R + j \omega L} = \frac{R - j \omega C \left[ R^2 + \omega L \left( \omega L - \frac{1}{\omega C} \right) \right]}{\omega^2 C^2 \left[ R^2 + \left( \omega L - \frac{1}{\omega C} \right)^2 \right]}\tag{5}$$

取模长

$$\left| Z \right| = \frac{\sqrt{R^{2} + \omega^{2}C^{2}[R^{2} + \omega L(\omega L - \frac{1}{\omega C})]^{2}}}{\omega^{2}C^{2}[R^{2} + (\omega L - \frac{1}{\omega C})^{2}]}\tag{6}$$

在 $R << \omega L , \frac{1}{\omega C}$ 的情况下，略去 $R^{2}$ 之后轻易可以发现

$$f_{c}=\frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}=\frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{\mu_{0}\epsilon_{0}\frac{R_{1}}{R_{1}+R_{2}}}}\tag{7}$$

代入可得

$$Z_{c} = \frac{\sqrt{1 + \omega^{2} C^{2} R^{2}}}{\omega^{2} C^{2} R},\tag{8}$$

(3)（3.1）由题意，载流子为电子，受到电场力 $- e E e^{i \omega t}$，及等效阻尼力 $- \frac{m \vec{v}}{\tau}$

$$m \frac{d \vec{v}}{dt} = - e E e^{i \omega t} - \frac{m \vec{v}}{\tau}.\tag{9}$$

代入试探解 $v = A e^{i \omega t}$

$$( i m \omega + \frac{m}{\tau} ) A e^{i \omega t} = - e E e^{i \omega t}\tag{10}$$

解得

$$v = \frac{- e E e^{i \omega t}}{i m \omega + \frac{m}{\tau}}\tag{11}$$

电流密度为

$$j = - n e v = \frac{n e^{2} E e^{i \omega t}}{i m \omega + \frac{m}{\tau}}\tag{12}$$

微观欧姆定律

$$j = \sigma E e^{i \omega t}\tag{13}$$

从而体系电导率为

$$\sigma = \frac{ne^{2}}{im\omega + \frac{m}{\tau}} = \frac{ne^{2}}{\sqrt{m^{2}\omega^{2} + \frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}e^{i\omega}\tag{14}$$

取模长

$$| \sigma | = \frac{n e^{2}}{\sqrt{m^{2} \omega^{2} + \frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}\tag{15}$$

(3.2) 令 $\kappa ( x ) = \frac{\pi^{2} k}{3 \epsilon^{2}} | \sigma | T ( x ) = a T ( x )$，分析平衡时微元 $x \sim x + dx$ 的传热。

$$- \kappa_{x} \pi ( R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2} ) \frac{d T}{d x} |_{x} + d P = - \kappa_{x+dx} \pi ( R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2} ) \frac{d T}{d x} |_{x+dx} + 2 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) d x A ( T - T_{0} )\tag{16}$$

整理

$$\kappa_{x+dx} \pi (R^{2}_{2} - R^{2}_{1}) \frac{\partial T}{\partial x}|_{x+dx} - \kappa_{x} \pi (R^{2}_{2} - R^{2}_{1}) \frac{\partial T}{\partial x}|_{x} = \pi (R^{2}_{2} - R^{2}_{1}) \frac{d}{dx} (\kappa(x) \frac{dT}{dx})$$

得到

$$\pi \left( R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2} \right) \frac{d}{d x} \left( a T \frac{d T}{d x} \right) = 2 \pi \left( R_{1} + R_{2} \right) A \left( T - T_{0} \right) - \frac{d P}{d x}\tag{17}$$

为了求解电功率 $d P / d x$，首先写出电流

$$j = \frac{\sqrt{2} i}{2 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) \lambda} e^{i \omega t}\tag{19}$$

对应电场

$$E = \frac{j}{\sigma} = \frac{\sqrt{2}i\sqrt{m^{2}\omega^{2} + \frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}{2\pi(R_{1} + R_{2})\lambda n e^{2}}e^{i(\omega t - \phi)}\tag{20}$$

从而热功率为

$$\frac{dP}{dx} = \frac{\vec{j} \cdot \vec{E}}{\left| \vec{j} \right| \cdot \frac{1}{\vec{E}} \cdot \frac{1}{dx}} = \frac{i^2 \sqrt{m^2 \omega^2 + \frac{1}{\tau^2}}}{2 \pi (R_1 + R_2) \lambda n e^2} \cos \phi = i^2 \frac{1}{\left| \sigma \right|} \frac{1}{2 \pi (R_1 + R_2) \lambda} \cos (\arctan (\omega \tau))\tag{21}$$

整理得

$$\pi ( R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2} ) a ( ( \frac{d T}{d x} )^{2} + T \frac{d^{2} T}{d x^{2}} ) = 2 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) A ( T - T_{0} ) - i^{2} \frac{1}{| \sigma |} \frac{1}{2 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) \lambda \sqrt{1 + \omega^{2} \tau^{2}}}\tag{22}$$

注意到 $\frac{d^{2} T}{d x^{2}} = \frac{1}{2} \frac{d T'^{2}}{d T}$，上式可化为

$$\frac{d T^{\prime 2}}{d T} + \frac{2}{T} T^{\prime 2} = \frac{2}{\pi ( R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2} ) a T} [ 2 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) A ( T - T_{0} ) - i^{2} \frac{1}{| \sigma |} \frac{1}{2 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) \lambda \sqrt{1 + \omega^{2} \tau^{2}} } ]\tag{23}$$

为标准的一阶线性微分方程，其通解

$$\begin{aligned}T^{\prime 2} = & e^{-\int \frac{2}{T}dT}(\int \frac{2}{\pi(R_2^2 - R_1^2)aT}[2\pi(R_1 + R_2)A(T - T_0)] \\- & i^2\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{1}{2\pi(R_1 + R_2)\lambda\sqrt{1 + \omega^2\tau^2}}]e^{\int \frac{2}{T}dT}dT + C)\end{aligned}\tag{24}$$

完成积分，并利用边界条件 $\left. T^{\prime} \right|_{x = 0} = 0$（$x = 0$ 处无热通量）定解

$$\begin{aligned} { T^{\prime 2} = \frac{2}{\pi ( R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2} )} } & { { } a T^{2} [ 2 \pi ( R_{1} - R_{2} ) A ( \frac{1}{3} ( T^{3} - T_{1}^{3} ) - \frac{1}{2} T_{0} ( T^{2} - T_{1}^{2} ) ) } \\ { } & { { } - i^{2} \frac{1}{| \sigma |} \frac{T^{2} - T_{1}^{2}}{4 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) \lambda \sqrt{1 + \omega^{2} \tau^{2}}} ] } \\ \end{aligned}\tag{25}$$

分离变量

$$d x = \frac{d T}{\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi(R_{1}^{2} - R_{2}^{2})[\ln T^{2}]}[2 \pi (R_{1} - R_{2})A(\frac{1}{3}(T^{3} - T_{1}^{3}) - \frac{1}{2}T_{1}(T^{2} - T_{1}^{2})) - i^{2} \frac{1}{\left| \eta \right|} \frac{T^{2} - T_{1}^{2}}{4 \pi (R_{1} - R_{2})[\ln T^{2} - \ln^{2} \tau^{2}]}]}}\tag{26}$$

假设 $T - T_{1} << T_{1}$，以后将看到其自洽性，则

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}(T^{3} - T_{1}^{3}) = \frac{1}{3}(T - T_{1})(T^{2} - TT_{1} - T_{1}^{2}) \approx T_{1}^{2}(T - T_{1}) \\\frac{1}{2}T_{0}(T^{2} - T_{1}^{2}) = \frac{1}{2}T_{0}(T + T_{1})(T - T_{1}) \approx T_{0}T_{1}(T - T_{1}) \\dx = \frac{TdT}{\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2})a}[2\pi(R_{1} + R_{2})AT_{1}(T_{1} - T_{0}) - i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T_{1}}{2\pi(R_{1} + R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1 - \omega^{3}\tau^{2}}}]\sqrt{T - T_{1}}}}\end{aligned}\tag{27}$$

完成积分

$$x = \frac{\frac{2}{3}(T - T_{1})^{\frac{3}{2}} + 2T_{1}\sqrt{T - T_{1}}}{\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2})\alpha}[2\pi(R_{1} + R_{2})AT_{1}(T_{1} - T_{0}) - i^{2}\frac{1}{\left| \sigma \right|}\frac{T_{1}}{2\pi(R_{1} + R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1 - \omega^{2}T^{2}}}]}}\tag{28}$$

注意到 $T - T_{1} << T_{1}$，括号内第二项远大于第一项，最低阶近似下可以略去第一项。反解得到

$$T ( x ) = T_{1} + \frac{x^{2}}{2 \pi ( R_{2}^{2} - R_{1}^{2} ) a T_{1}^{2}} \left[ 2 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) A T_{1} ( T_{1} - T_{0} ) - i^{2} \frac{1}{| \sigma |} \frac{T_{1}}{2 \pi ( R_{1} + R_{2} ) \lambda \sqrt{1 + \omega^{2} \tau^{2}}} \right]\tag{29}$$

上式即确定温度分布 $T(x)$，其中 $a = \frac{\pi^{2} k}{3 \epsilon^{2}} | \sigma |$。不难发现，$T - T_{1} << T_{1}$ 自洽。

questions.title: 第 07 题
tags: 光学/波动光学/衍射/菲涅耳衍射

questions.content:
七、(1)

(1.1) 矩孔衍射，从次波源相干叠加的观点写出菲涅尔衍射积分式，忽略倾斜因子。注意运算式不要落下 $\frac{-i}{\lambda}$ 因子，记得 $\frac{1}{r}\to\frac{1}{f}$ 变换。

$$u(P)=-\frac{i}{\lambda}\int_{-\frac{a}{2}}^{\frac{a}{2}}\int_{-\frac{a}{2}}^{\frac{a}{2}}u_{0}\frac{e^{ik\cdot r}}{f}dxdy,$$

$$U_{0}=\frac{-ia^{2}u_{0}}{\lambda f}\frac{\sin\alpha_{0}}{\alpha_{0}}\frac{\sin\beta_{0}}{\beta_{0}}\tag{1}$$

$$I=\frac{a^{4}u_{0}^{2}}{\lambda^{2}f^{2}}\left(\frac{\sin\alpha_{0}}{\alpha_{0}}\right)^{2}\left(\frac{\sin\beta_{0}}{\beta_{0}}\right)^{2}\tag{2}$$

其中 $\alpha_{0}=\frac{\pi a\sin\theta_{1}}{\lambda}$，$\beta_{0}=\frac{\pi a\sin\theta_{2}}{\lambda}$

(1.2)衍射孔位移相当于附加相位差。在复振幅表述下相当于乘了一个复的相位因子。

$$e^{i\delta}=e^{ik(a\sin\theta_{1}+a\sin\theta_{2})}\tag{3}$$

(2)

(2.1)我们将八个小孔分别编号为1~8，写出他们的复振幅分别如下

$$u_{i}=c_{i}\frac{\sin\alpha_{1}}{\alpha_{1}}\frac{\sin\beta_{1}}{\beta_{1}}\tag{4}$$

$$\begin{aligned}c_{1}&=\frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})}\\c_{2}&=\frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})}\\c_{3}&=\frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(-ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})}\\c_{4}&=\frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(-ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})}\\c_{5}&=\frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(ka\sin\theta_{1})}\\c_{6}&=\frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(ka\sin\theta_{2})}\\c_{7}&=\frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(-ka\sin\theta_{1})}\\c_{8}&=\frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(-ka\sin\theta_{2})}\end{aligned}\tag{5-12}$$

求和得

$$\begin{aligned}U_{1}&=\sum_{i=1}^{8}u_{i}\\&=\frac{2}{9}c_{0}\frac{\sin\alpha_{1}}{\alpha_{1}}\frac{\sin\beta_{1}}{\beta_{1}}[\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})\\&\quad+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{2})]\\&=C_{1}\frac{\sin\alpha_{1}}{\alpha_{1}}\frac{\sin\beta_{1}}{\beta_{1}}\end{aligned}\tag{13}$$

其中有 $\alpha_{0}=3\alpha_{1},\beta_{0}=3\beta_{1}$

(2.2)将 $C_{1}$ 作为新一代的 $c_{0}$，直接带入变换式，注意作变换 $a\to\frac{3a}{3}$

$$\begin{aligned}U_{2}=\frac{2}{9}C_{1}\frac{\sin\alpha_{2}}{\alpha_{2}}\frac{\sin\beta_{2}}{\beta_{2}}[&\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3}+\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3}\\&+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}}{3}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}]\\=\frac{2}{9}\left(\frac{2}{9}c_{0}[\right.&\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1})\\&\left.+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{2})]\frac{\sin\alpha_{2}}{\alpha_{2}}\frac{\sin\beta_{2}}{\beta_{2}}[\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3}\right.\\&+\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}}{3}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}]\\=\left(\frac{2}{9}\right)^{2}&c_{0}\frac{\sin\alpha_{2}}{\alpha_{2}}\frac{\sin\beta_{2}}{\beta_{2}}[\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})\\&+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{2})][\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3}\\&+\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}}{3}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}]\end{aligned}\tag{14}$$

其中有 $\alpha_{1}=3\alpha_{2},\beta_{1}=3\beta_{2}$

如此迭代N代再求和，即得最终康托尔地毯的衍射复振幅分布。

$$\begin{aligned}u_{N}&=\sum U_{N}\\&=c_{0}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}\left\{\left(\frac{2}{9}\right)^{n}c_{0}\frac{\sin\alpha_{n}}{\alpha_{n}}\frac{\sin\beta_{n}}{\beta_{n}}\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\left[\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3^{i}}\right.\right.\\&\quad+\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3^{i}}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}}{3^{i}}\left.\left.+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3^{i}}\right]\right\}\end{aligned}\tag{15}$$

需要注意的是，当 $n=0$，我们应当默认连乘项为常数1。

questions.content:
八、（1）波矢空间内电子的能量

$$\frac{\hbar^2}{2}\frac{k_1^2}{m_1 E}+\frac{\hbar^2}{2}\frac{k_2^2}{m_2 E}+\frac{\hbar^2}{2}\frac{k_3^2}{m_3 E}=1\tag{1}$$

该式为椭球，说明波矢空间内的电子等能面为椭球。

等能体积为

$$V=\frac{4}{3}\pi\frac{2\sqrt{2}\sqrt{m_1 m_2 m_3}E^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\hbar^3}.\tag{2}$$

取微分，则处于 $E\sim E+dE$ 的相体积为

$$dV=4\pi\frac{\sqrt{2}\sqrt{m_1 m_2 m_3}E^{\frac{1}{2}}}{\hbar^3}dE.\tag{3}$$

该相体积元含有的状态数为

$$dN=2\times\frac{V_c dV}{(2\pi)^3}\tag{4}$$

代入，得到

$$dN=\frac{V_c\sqrt{2}\sqrt{m_1 m_2 m_3}E^{\frac{1}{2}}}{\pi^2\hbar^3}dE\tag{5}$$

积分得到

$$N=\frac{2}{3}\frac{V_c\sqrt{2}\sqrt{m_1 m_2 m_3}E^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\pi^2\hbar^3}\tag{6}$$

从而费米能

$$E_F=\left(\frac{3}{2}\frac{N\pi^2\hbar^3}{V_c\sqrt{2m_1 m_2 m_3}}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}}\tag{7}$$

（2）据题意

$$\begin{pmatrix}a_1\\a_2\\a_3\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}\frac{1}{m_1}&&\\&\frac{1}{m_2}&\\&&\frac{1}{m_3}\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}F_1\\F_2\\F_3\end{pmatrix}\tag{8}$$

电子受力为洛伦兹力

$$\vec{F}=-e\vec{v}\times\vec{B}\tag{9}$$

其中

$$\vec{v}=(v_1,v_2,v_3),\quad \vec{B}=B(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)\tag{10,11}$$

从而分量形式为

$$\begin{aligned}F_1&=-e(v_2 B\gamma-v_3 B\beta),\\F_2&=-e(v_3 B\alpha-v_1 B\gamma),\\F_3&=-e(v_1 B\beta-v_2 B\alpha).\end{aligned}\tag{12-14}$$

代入得到运动方程

$$\begin{aligned}m_1 a_1&=-e(v_2 B\gamma-v_3 B\beta)\\m_2 a_2&=-e(v_3 B\alpha-v_1 B\gamma)\\m_3 a_3&=-e(v_1 B\beta-v_2 B\alpha)\end{aligned}\tag{15-17}$$

电子作周期运动，试探

$$v_1=v_{10}e^{i\omega t},\quad v_2=v_{20}e^{i\omega t},\quad v_3=v_{30}e^{i\omega t}.\tag{18-20}$$

代入得到

$$\begin{pmatrix}i\omega m_1&eB\gamma&-eB\beta\\eB\gamma&-i\omega m_2&-eB\alpha\\eB\beta&-eB\alpha&i\omega m_3\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}v_{10}\\v_{20}\\v_{30}\end{pmatrix}=0\tag{21}$$

上式有非零列向量解 $(v_{10},v_{20},v_{30})^t$ 的条件为

$$\det\begin{pmatrix}i\omega m_1&eB\gamma&-eB\beta\\eB\gamma&-i\omega m_2&-eB\alpha\\eB\beta&-eB\alpha&i\omega m_3\end{pmatrix}=0.\tag{22}$$

其中 $\det\{\}$ 表示矩阵的行列式。

由此解得

$$\omega=eB\sqrt{\frac{m_1\alpha^2+m_2\beta^2+m_3\gamma^2}{m_1 m_2 m_3}}.\tag{23}$$

该式显然具有对 $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ 及 $m_1,m_2,m_3$ 的轮换对称性。
questions.answer:
（1）费米能 $E_F=\left(\dfrac{3}{2}\dfrac{N\pi^2\hbar^3}{V_c\sqrt{2m_1 m_2 m_3}}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}}$；

（2）回旋角频率 $\omega=eB\sqrt{\dfrac{m_1\alpha^2+m_2\beta^2+m_3\gamma^2}{m_1 m_2 m_3}}$，该式对 $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ 及 $m_1,m_2,m_3$ 具有轮换对称性。
